goals.name: Gradual return to regular activity and walking
goals.description: Restore baseline daily activity and walking tolerance while protecting the C-section incision and avoiding abdominal loading until 6-week OB check.

goals.name: Re-establish gentle core control and pelvic floor awareness
goals.description: Gentle pelvic floor and breathing-based core activation exercises, avoiding direct abdominal strain until clearance.

inputs.label: OB clearance for heavy lifting/abs at 6 weeks

actions.note: Keep core-loading exercises as gentle activation and breathing; omit heavy/core-loading activities until clearance.
Recommend rest/medical review and substitute with gentle walking and breathwork.

activities.name: Seated pelvic tilts & diaphragmatic breathing (no crunches)

days.name: Gentle mobility and pelvic floor cueing

phases.name: Weeks 3–4: Increase walking and gentle functional movement
Weeks 5–6: Pre-clearance progression (continued low-load); prepare for 6-week check

days.name: Rest and OB check if scheduled

phases.name: Weeks 7–8: Post-OB clearance — reintroduce progressive loading cautiously
Weeks 9–10: Progressive conditioning and strength foundation

activities.name: Bodyweight circuit (squat, row, hinge, glute bridge)

checkpoints.name: 6-week OB check
questions: Has your OB cleared you for abdominal loading and heavier lifting?
Are you experiencing pain with movement or at the incision site?

checkpoints.name: 12-week consolidation checkpoint
questions: Do you feel ready to progress to higher-load training?
